Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDesc: Pipes auto-connect into a network. Plumb sinks, showers and toilets, and link rain collectors, barrels and vessels to share water. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRiserDesc: A vertical pipe cover for a wall. Connects floor pipes on both sides of the wall and links different floors. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeHiddenDesc: A concealed water pipe: recessed and plastered over so it stays out of sight, while still auto-connecting and carrying water like a normal pipe. Reveal it with 'Show pipe network'. Needs a Pipe Wrench, Plaster Powder and some water.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRiserHiddenDesc: A concealed vertical pipe: plastered into the wall so it stays out of sight, while still linking floors and connecting pipes across the wall. Reveal it with 'Show pipe network'. Needs a Pipe Wrench, Plaster Powder and some water.
